title: Consumer app website with acquisition funnel
summary: A product site whose job is to funnel visitors into signing up or installing, set expectations of the app's core loop, and get new users to first value.
defaults: Make signup or install the single dominant action
Preview the app's actual core surfaces, not marketing abstractions
Treat onboarding and first-run empty states as spec views
risks: Marketing copy with no visible product surfaces
Signup not modeled as a first-class flow
verification: Reach signup or install in one obvious step
Complete a first-run onboarding path to first value
See the app's core surface with sensible empty-state content
site_goals: Acquire users by driving signup or install
Get new users to first value through onboarding
Set expectations of the app's core loop before signup
